relationships.subject: environmental enrichment
relationships.evidence_quote: Converging preclinical evidence indicates that EE attenuates NLRP3 signaling and downstream inflammation across distinct pathophysiological contexts (Table 2).

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition of NLRP3 with the selective inhibitor MCC950 was effective in both sexes, but had longer-lasting effects in males, suggesting sex-dependent regulation (31).

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome expression and activity differ by sex across neuropathic pain, substance use, stress and aging.
Environmental enrichment and exercise dampen NLRP3 priming and activation, whereas social isolation and impoverished housing increase it.
